name: Shiko and Narset, Unified
oracle_text:
Flying, vigilance
Flurry — Whenever you cast your second spell each turn, copy that spell if it targets a permanent or player, and you may choose new targets for the copy. If you don't copy a spell this way, draw a card.
blocked_sentences: Flurry — Whenever you cast your second spell each turn, copy that spell if it targets a permanent or player, and you may choose new targets for the copy. If you don't copy a spell this way, draw a card.

needs.what: a condition a spell_cast trigger can ask about the cast spell's PLAYER targets as well as its object targets -- "if it targets a permanent or player" -- e.g. an event binding of the seats the spell targeted (spell_target_players) or a condition key `spell_targets_any: ["permanent", "player"]`, usable in an `if` whose then is copy_spell (new_targets, sid of the triggering spell) and whose else is draw 1
needs.why_existing_wont_do: The spell_cast event binding `spell_targets` (Game._cast) carries only targets of kind "object", deliberately dropping player targets, so `exists` over it answers "targets a permanent" but a spell aimed only at a player (Lightning Bolt to the face, Fact or Fiction-style target-player spells) would wrongly fall into the draw branch instead of being copied. No condition_keys or value_keys entry reads a spell's player targets. The rest of the line (trigger nth: 2 on spell_cast controller you, copy_spell with new_targets, if/else draw) appears expressible once that condition exists; the sid binding naming the triggering spell for copy_spell should also be confirmed.
